text_block_list.text:
A rest day. Opening the door to my room,
I heard pitter-pattering footsteps alongside a wonderful aroma.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Trainer-san.
Thank you so much for going shopping~!
choice_data_list: Yeah. How are things going on your end?
Yeah. How are things going on your end?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
For now, I've made a bit of everything
I wanted to put in the bento~
Could you do a taste test for me?
It was a few days ago when Super Creek asked if she could borrow the kitchen in my room...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"There's a flower-viewing trip coming up at the daycare back home...
...Though, there's one child with a frail constitution who won't be able to join."

"We want to hold an indoor picnic for her,"
"but we can't monopolize the dormitory kitchen."
...And so, the lot fell upon my house.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"She loves cute things, so
I tried making it look cute too~
What do you think?"
The little chick-shaped boiled eggs, the flower sausages, and the bear-shaped hamburg steaks—not only are they all adorable, but they taste amazing too!
choice_data_list: Delicious! Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my!
I am so glad to hear that~♪"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is the portion size and nutritional balance~.
Balancing the main dish with the sides...
What should we do for snacks~?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so glad they had plenty
of glow-in-the-dark cherry blossom stickers~!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I can let that child play with the stickers...
and if we pair it with a home planetarium,
we could have a lovely cherry blossom viewing party~♪"
choice_data_list: You're really thinking about a lot of things, aren't you?
You've got a lot on your mind, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Of course♪ Come! Once we get back,
let's do a practice run making the boxed lunches for that day.

"And so, Super Creek made all sorts of preparations,
and when the day arrived, I was invited as well."

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if everyone's at the park already~...
They said they're playing color tag and hide-and-seek~."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. Then we shouldn't let them beat us,
we've gotta have just as much fun playing~!
choice_data_list: First off... this!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Flower stickers!
There are so many of them!?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"As a special treat today! Let's stick these decals on the wall
and play 'The Old Man Who Made Withered Trees Blossom'~."
choice_data_list: Let's bloom just as brightly as the cherry blossoms outside!
Let's bloom just as brightly as the cherry blossoms outside!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! My lunchbox has a bear-shaped hamburg steak!
And the rice balls are little birds!
choice_data_list: Let's play an animal guessing game while we eat!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
Now then, make sure to wipe your hands clean~.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Fwaah~! The stars are so pwetty~...
The pwanetawium is so amazing, huh...!
choice_data_list: Look at the flower sticker I just put on!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
! It's glowing!!
Soooo coooool!!!!

And so we enjoyed our indoor picnic...
and before we knew it, it was time for
the outdoor excursion group to return.

text_block_list.name: Kindergartner
text_block_list.text:
—Catching cherry blossom petals
was super duper fun!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
"I played the blooming old man!
When it gets dark, it glows,
and I did flower viewing with a... puranetarium?"

text_block_list.name: Kindergartner
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? It glows!?
I wanna do it too! Teacher, let me try!
choice_data_list: That indoor picnic was a huge success, huh!
That indoor picnic was a huge success, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I'm really glad.
Seeing them enjoy it enough to brag about it like that.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: As an athlete myself, I understand all too well the frustration of being held back by your physical condition.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that doesn't mean
I have to give up on having fun, right?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'd be glad if even a small part of them remembers
that you can still have fun even with a frail body.
choice_data_list: So that's why you were working so hard.
So that's why you were working so hard!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. For the sake of that smile, I could keep working hard forever and ever~♪
"Even so, it's not the off-season right now. Balancing that with training must have been tough. Is there anything I can do—"
choice_data_list: You did great, there, there.
What would you like as a reward?

text_block_list.text: Saying so, I pretended to pat her on the head. Our usual roles were reversed.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...
Ehehe, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There, there, Trainer...
Good boy, good boy...
choice_data_list: I didn't do anything, though?
I didn't do anything, did I?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to tell the truth, in today's boxed lunch...
I included that thing you dislike, Trainer...
choice_data_list: Eeeh, you mean THAT... THAT!?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes♪ A looot of it on the hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu! Good job eating it all up~.
Who's a good girl? Good girl♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
A reward?
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ah! Well then, I'd love to visit your place again sometime, Trainer~.
choice_data_list: Huh, why!?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The laundry was piling up,
and the fridge was completely bare, so...
choice_data_list: Ugh...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So for my reward,
I'd love to take care of you, Trainer~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Please let me take lots of care
of you, my hardworking Trainer♪
